# Historical RunCat reference (not part of 0.5.0 runtime)

Earlier rejected drafts used images from Kyome22/menubar_runcat, commit `82747b139cc32e13a7b713f8521f44c70317f7d4`, under Apache-2.0. That historical license is retained here only for the old reference record.

Version 0.5.0 replaces all upstream cat images with an original chubby cat. No RunCat image was provided as an image-generation reference for the new cat. Runtime resources and the App/DMG contain only the new original cat and Makima artwork. The old upstream reference and license are not required by or bundled into the 0.5.0 App.
